purpose: Find substantial audience-interest omissions from the completed original 150-show yearly review while respecting approvals, declines and format exclusions.
source_explanation: IMDb numVotes is the count of rating votes, not viewers. Two thousand votes is a conservative discovery screen for a much larger audience. It is not the eligibility rule: additional lower-vote culturally prominent shows are included. IMDb start years are checked against programme records; public aired pilots and original web series can precede regular seasons.
coverage_limits: No popularity dataset proves universal completeness. This audit explicitly records the screened universe and exclusions; programmes without positive language/origin evidence are not silently labelled eligible.

film_boundary_screen.title: Bury My Heart at Wounded Knee
The Five People You Meet in Heaven

boundary_notes: Introductory Battlestar Galactica miniseries and companion webisodes remain one approved edition.
The public pilots of Todd Margaret, Hardcore Pawn, Limmy's Show and Fonejacker establish earlier years than some regular-season indexes.
Childrens Hospital starts with its public 2008 web season.
Little Britain uses its TV premiere rather than its earlier radio premiere.
Hogfather and Uprising qualify as genuinely multipart serial television despite aggregate TV-movie database labels. Standalone movies and companion features stay excluded.
Power Rangers named seasonal arcs are covered by the existing franchise entry, not treated as new series every season.
Napoleon qualifies through its English-language production and Canadian/US/UK co-producers. Mary Bryant qualifies through its verified British-Australian co-production.
All Star Family Fortunes is a licensed Family Feud edition; both it and Celebrity Family Feud receive the owner's standing franchise approval.
